may_not_pay: Rehat pays only when NEA's published readings at your named station cross the levels shown; your own site can be hotter or wetter than the station, so you can lose work time and receive nothing.
sms: Rehat pays $8/worker/hr when NEA heat (WBGT 32+), heavy rain or haze at your station runs above a normal month. Station only: you may lose time and get $0.

essential.heat_basis: Station normal: mean hours of mandated rest a worker for this calendar month, 2000 to 2024, from NEA WBGT where observed and corrected ERA5 rebuild elsewhere.
essential.rain_basis: Station normal: mean rain hours a worker for this calendar month, 2000 to 2024, estimated from the nearest MSS daily record (calibrated on 1513 station-days where NEA 5-minute gauges and MSS daily records overlap; missing MSS station-days, including before a local station began, use Changi on the same date).
